dimensions.assessment: Affects a specific, defined cohort of U.S. Customs and Border Protection officers hired around July 2008 and retired or retiring personnel.
dimensions.evidence: Eligible Individual means any individual who-- (1) received a tentative offer of employment... before July 6, 2008; and (2) entered into duty... on or after July 6, 2008

dimensions.assessment: Provides significant individual financial and retirement benefit corrections, including retroactive adjustments and mandatory retirement exemptions.
dimensions.evidence: entitled to--(A) the minimum annuity amount... and (B) an exemption from mandatory retirement

dimensions.assessment: Involves retroactive and ongoing annuity adjustments for a specific group of officers, though no aggregate dollar sum is provided.
dimensions.evidence: including a retroactive annuity adjustment for Eligible Individuals who retired before the date of the enactment of this Act

dimensions.assessment: Targets retirement eligibility rules for a specific group of federal law enforcement officers and requires a GAO review of CBP hiring practices.
dimensions.evidence: To correct the inequitable denial of enhanced retirement and annuity benefits to certain U.S. Customs and Border Protection Officers.

dimensions.assessment: Permanent corrections to individual retirement annuities and a one-time GAO study report.

importance_detail.rationale: The bill corrects retirement and annuity calculations for certain U.S. Customs and Border Protection officers who received tentative offers before July 6, 2008, and started work on or after that date.
